title: Steam Next Fest Demo Teaser (15s)
summary: A 15-second teaser that tells festival browsers a playable demo exists: a two-second gameplay hook, a quick look at what the demo contains, a cliffhanger tease of what lies beyond it, and a clean end hold for Play the demo text. Built for autoplay on a store page with the sound off.
prompt:
A 15-second teaser for the playable demo of an indie game, designed to autoplay muted on a store page during a demo festival. Every second must read without sound.

Game: {argument name="game_pitch" default="a cozy-creepy fishing adventure where you sail a tiny boat across a foggy archipelago and catch strange creatures"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="low-poly 3D with soft flat shading, chunky outlines and painterly skies"}.
Camera: {argument name="camera" default="the game camera, a three-quarter chase view behind the boat"}, steady and readable.

# Timeline
- 0-2s HOOK: open mid-action on the most surprising thing in the demo: {argument name="hook_moment" default="the fishing line goes taut and something enormous with glowing eyes surfaces right beside the boat"}.
- 2-9s WHAT YOU CAN PLAY: three fast, clear beats of the demo content: {argument name="demo_beats" default="casting the line at sunset, upgrading the boat at a lantern-lit dock, and logging a weird fish in a hand-drawn journal"}. Each beat holds long enough to understand.
- 9-12s BEYOND THE DEMO: a short tease of something the demo does not include: {argument name="tease" default="a vast silhouette of a sunken city glimpsed under the fog, the boat turning toward it"}, ending on a hard cut to black.
- 12-15s END HOLD: a calm, slowly drifting frame of {argument name="end_frame" default="the little boat bobbing on calm water under a big moon"}, with a clean empty band in the lower third for the text Play the demo now, added in the editor.

# Readability
- High contrast subject, minimal HUD, no tiny details carrying meaning. Assume viewers see it at 600 pixels wide.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="misty teal and lavender with warm lantern orange accents"}.

# Avoid
Generated text, festival or store logos, platform badges, age-rating icons, flickering geometry, inconsistent boat design between beats, watermarks.
